notes.title: Free Art (Adult Content)
notes.notes:
This is a free DLC that adds art content.

This DLC does not add anything to the game. You need to open the file to find it.

Example file location =

D:\Steam\Steam\steamapps\common\LVN Fake News\Art

To install the DLC, go to you library and find LVN Fake News. There should be a place to manage DLC. Make sure the box is checked. (I'm not sure if the download button will do this.)


Artwork was done by FluffyDus and gin-1994.
These artists can be contacted through deviantart.

notes.title: Russian Subtitles
notes.notes:
Welcome Comrades

LVN Fake News now has Russian text in the dialogue 
(ie. When characters are talking to each other.) 

To access the translation select "New Game."  You will be given the option of English or Russian.


[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/33183935/193b1c787310bde653d9e0b3b625dd90f0ce200e.png[/img]

This translation was completed by this Steam user:
(If you would like a translation, I highly recommend his services.)

https://steamcommunity.com/id/lomachevsky



*If you would like to translate this game or one of my other games you don't need Visual Novel Maker to do so.  If you can access Microsoft Excel then translation requires no coding knowledge on your part.

notes.title: LVN2 CG artist found
notes.notes:
If you missed the last announcement, I'm making a semi sequel to LVN Fake News.  I'll be using the same background artist as before.

[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/33183935/0c8b62fe7297e09520e28dbf13bca758b8ee808c.png[/img]

notes.title: New VN Coming!
notes.notes:
I'm currently working on a semi-sequel to LVN Fake News. The VN will use the same characters and will still have some focus on news reporting. The game will provide further depth to the LVN story, but new players won't be alienated if they haven't played LVN Fake News. The story will center around the news team going to a farm and investigating a story around there.

Background art is being done by gin-1994, the same person who worked on the backgrounds for LVN Fake News. I haven't yet determined who will do the CGs for this game.


Sample art used while in Visual Novel Maker
[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/33183935/6b7461674e51b8b68a7f3a2dae3ceeb5474d4112.png[/img]

Game is still in early development. Release date is unknown at this time.
